text:
The median asking rent in Bonn stands at 13.54 €/m², up 4.6 % year‑on‑year and 24.3 % over the past five years, placing the city 12th among the 37 most expensive German markets. A typical 60 m² unit costs about 812 € per month, while the asking premium over existing rents is 49 %.

The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and properties staying on the market for only 23 days; 34 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 16.8 %, reflecting limited affordability despite modest mortgage rates at 4.01 %.

The model‑based forecast projects the median asking rent to reach 14.3 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 13.93 €/m² and 14.64 €/m², implying a 5.6 % increase.
